baslik: How does a nuclear power plant make electricity? ⚛️ #shorts
aciklama:
Energy Sources, episode 4: the atom. Fission, the chain reaction and control rods, fuel pellet, rod and 17×17 assembly (264 rods), pressure vessel and steam generators, turbine, passive safety and Plant Vogtle. Model: AP1000 pressurised water reactor (about 3,400 MWt, over 1,117 MWe), the design of Vogtle Units 3 and 4. Plant Vogtle (Georgia): 4 units, about 4,664 MW in total, the largest nuclear plant in the US. 3D model is illustrative.
Satellite imagery: NASA GIBS (HLS, MODIS, Blue Marble), public domain.

Narration uses an AI voice clone; visuals are code-generated 3D animation; music is an original AI-generated track.

#nuclearenergy #nuclearpower #vogtle #AP1000 #kozmoslab #shorts
